title: avenula breviaristata
intro: Avenula breviaristata, commonly known as Short-haired oat-grass, is a species of grass in the genus Avenula. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including being used to treat digestive issues and as a natural diuretic to reduce fluid retention. The therapeutic actions of Avenula breviaristata include its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, and its antispasmodic properties, which can help to relax muscles and reduce cramping. The bioactive constituents of Avenula breviaristata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
